AI WORKFLOW

How I use AI without letting it replace engineering judgment._

A practical operating loop for turning unclear work into shipped software: clarify, scaffold, code, review, test, document, and ship.

01

Capture & Clarify

Turn rough notes, screenshots, and requirements into explicit acceptance criteria before building.

02

Plan & Scaffold

Break down implementation slices, inspect existing patterns, and scaffold the smallest useful structure.

03

Code with AI

Use agents as accelerators for exploration, implementation, and review while keeping engineering judgment in the loop.

04

Test & Refine

Run targeted checks, inspect failures, compare screenshots for UI work, and iterate until behavior is verified.

05

Document & Ship

Leave behind README notes, agent guidance, handoff context, and release-ready evidence.

/workflow/operating-rules.txt

  • Prefer clear repo instructions, acceptance criteria, and small verifiable changes.
  • Use AI for exploration, drafting, refactoring support, screenshot comparison, and review pressure.
  • Do not trust generated code without running checks and validating the product behavior.
